info.description: A known section name for ONE publication (e.g. 'National News' for NV) — scoped by publicationCode rather than one global list, so a second publication's own section names aren't forced into New Vision's vocabulary. Used by the ingest engine to recognize a page's detected section header cleanly; a page whose header doesn't match any entry here still keeps whatever text was actually detected (see Page.section) rather than being dropped to null — this collection is a naming aid, not a hard constraint.

publicationCode.description: Matches Edition.publicationCode — which publication this section name belongs to.

skipStoryExtraction.description: When true, the ingest engine never attempts story extraction on a page whose detected section matches this entry — the page image is still created and viewable, just with no Story candidates. Meant for sections that are structurally not editorial content (Crocs, Adverts/Advert, Advertorial, Leisure, PLE, OLEVEL, ALEVEL, per the initial list) or that keep producing garbled/wrong extractions for reasons specific to that section's layout. Growable over time through Strapi admin — flip this flag on a new entry rather than needing a code change each time a new section needs excluding.
